title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Solid Brass, Wall Mount - Retractable Hooks And Garment Rods Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get the hanging space you need in the bathroom—without a hook constantly protruding into the room. This modern retractable wall hook pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not in use.

  • Cleaner, space-saving profile: retractable rod stores back into the wall when you’re done.
  • Secure everyday storage: supports up to 15 lb for robes, towels, and coats.
  • Designed to coordinate: part of the retractable hooks and garment rods collection with multiple designer finish options available.
  • Match your existing hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own.
  • Complete install kit: wall mount design includes all mounting hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Pull-out hanging space: 2-1/2 in
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in x 2 in x 3.75 in
  • Projection: 1 in
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Installation notes: requires drilling a 3/4 in diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around; toggle bolts included (6/32 toggles).
